name: Diff view
description: 任务最终回复末尾的文件变更汇总，点击定位本插件右侧 diff；保留 Git 审查、逐行反馈和受保护操作。
author: new-Beginner
safetyNotes: 可信本地插件：Agent 和 renderer 扩展没有 OS 沙箱；Node/Git 操作不受宿主 fs 网关逐次约束。只采集 Write/Edit 明确触及的普通文件，不扫描磁盘或从 Bash 推测路径。工作区外文件只读记录，没有恢复权限；工作区内恢复要求当前项目授权、完整任务归因、指纹校验、备份和手动确认。拒绝凭据、应用私有数据、UNC/设备/ADS、链接祖先及依赖/内部路径。无网络、模型调用、自动发送、提交或推送，不读取宿主数据库。文末卡片使用公开回复插槽；点击时仅复用固定 0.17.0 构建的内部插件页签工厂和工作面板接口，不操作原生审阅 DOM 或改写工具消息。宿主构建不匹配时拒绝自动跳转。临时选择只在插件内存中保存，按会话隔离。

en.description: Per-task reply-end file summaries linked to the plugin's own diff sidebar, plus bounded Git review and inline comments.
en.safetyNotes: Trusted unsandboxed Agent and renderer extensions; Node/Git adapters work outside the host filesystem gateway. Captures only explicit supported file-tool targets; external files are read-only. No disk scanning, network, model calls, automatic chat sending, commit/push, host database reads or transcript mutation. Auto-open pins one inspected PI-Desktop 0.17.0 build and calls only the internal plugin-tab factory and work-panel opener; no native review DOM manipulation. Unknown builds fail closed. Volatile navigation tokens are session-guarded.
